name: Ibaraki Douji
description: (Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)Shuten Douji's fierce subordinate with immense physical power and a large cursed bone sword. A powerful Oni, she unleashes sweltering, crushing flames. Her Noble Phantasm detaches a growing independent hand or fires fiercer charring flames, and as a Heroic Spirit her strength depends on her master's mana.
